question: Do people with ET or PD whose writing is affected still write by hand every week?
metric: Share of respondents with S7 >= 1 who write any of lists, notes, forms, signatures or cards by hand every day or a few times a week (S8 a-e)
sample: >= 100 ET and >= 100 PD; reported per diagnosis
grey_zone_action: 30-50 %: second survey wave of 100; no build funds meanwhile
options_gated: active pen; desk surface; tablet app (paper-practice features)
label: ASSUMPTION (threshold)
basis: General-population reference: 62 % of GB adults aged 65+ write short lists by hand at least weekly (HAP-158)

question: Is there a paper-bound job that no current alternative serves?
metric: Share with at least one avoided, delegated or rejected paper task in the last 3 months (S10) that could not have been typed, dictated or done online (S11)
grey_zone_action: 15-30 %: define the job precisely in interviews and retest
label: ASSUMPTION (threshold)
basis: Signature requirements persist for wills, powers of attorney and postal votes (PDT-105) and US mail ballots (PDT-106)

question: Are cheap passive aids insufficient?
metric: Among those who tried a weighted or grip pen (S12), share scoring it <= 5 of 10
no_go_threshold: >= 70 % score it >= 7 of 10 (passive aids already suffice)
grey_zone_action: otherwise: make the weighted pen the primary comparator and require a larger margin in EXP-U07
label: ASSUMPTION (threshold)
basis: Users rated a weighted spoon as highly as an active one (ACT-18) and preferred it in ET (ACT-19)

question: Do typing or dictation already meet most needs?
metric: Share answering 'almost all' or 'most' to S15 with typing or dictation difficulty 'none' or 'some' (S13, S14)
grey_zone_action: 50-70 %: focus paper products on the paper-bound jobs of GNG-2 only
label: ASSUMPTION (threshold)
basis: Typing or mouse use affected in 54 % of IETF respondents (PDT-99); dictation word errors 36.3 % on PD speech in a research test (PDT-104)

question: Would enough people pay a price the active pen can be made for?
metric: In the serviceable subgroup (S7 >= 2 and GNG-1 weekly writing), share answering 'Definitely' at the 500 price arm of S18
sample: >= 25 serviceable respondents in the 500 and the 250 arms
grey_zone_action: 10-20 %: pursue cost-down or a lower-cost option first
label: ASSUMPTION (threshold)
basis: Price implied by the Rev K cost estimate, roughly 450-1400 USD before any retail margin (CALCULATION, docs/market_and_users.md 6.1)

question: Do people ask to be kept informed when they see an honest description?
metric: Confirmed waitlist sign-ups / unique visitors, per consumer concept and price arm
options_gated: active pen; tablet app; desk surface
label: ASSUMPTION (threshold)

question: Will clinicians recommend and host?
metric: Of 12-16 clinicians interviewed: number who would recommend trying a proven device, and number of services willing to host EXP-U06 or EXP-U08
grey_zone_action: otherwise: go only for options that do not need clinicians
options_gated: therapy tool; measuring pen; tablet app
label: ASSUMPTION (threshold)
basis: Clinician route matters for NHS provision and VAT-relief advice (PDT-117)

question: Is there demand for a measuring pen in clinics and trials?
metric: Written expressions of interest from trial sponsors, CROs or academic groups among >= 10 approached; co-funded pilots within 6 months
data_source: EXP-U03; EXP-U05 page D; direct approaches
go_threshold: >= 3 expressions of interest and >= 1 co-funded pilot
grey_zone_action: 1-2: keep as an academic research tool only
label: ASSUMPTION (threshold)
basis: 80 industry phase 2/3 PD drug trials and 2 ET trials open or active on 2026-09-30 (PDT-116)

question: Do children with writing difficulty have an unmet school writing job?
metric: Among >= 100 parents or teachers surveyed: share reporting daily handwriting at school and at least one writing job unmet by current support
grey_zone_action: 20-30 %: narrow to a specific age or task
label: ASSUMPTION (threshold)
basis: Exams in England stay mainly on paper (HAP-153, HAP-154)

question: Can the active pen make severely tremulous writing readable on real inputs?
metric: DEC-055's line: at the severe class, >= +2 readable words of 10 over the ordinary pen, 95 % interval above 0, clean real writing moved <= 25 um on average and no writer > 50 um
label: project decision (DEC-055)
basis: No causal tracker passes today (docs/readable_target.md; docs/claims_register.md)
